description: A Probabilistic Assessment of Tsunami Hazard in the Indian Ocean is a dataset listed in South Australian Government data directory (data.sa.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Geoscience Australia. The Indian Ocean Tsunami of December 26, 2004 made starkly evident the need for better information on tsunami hazard in the Indian Ocean. Coverage: South Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Geoscience Australia. Its tags are Earth Sciences, GA Publication, Professional Opinion, earthquakes, geohazards. It offers 2 resource(s) in pdf, zip. The portal shows 2023-08-11 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-sa.
